subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Caffeine and Alzheimer's Risk
description: A fast breakdown of Caffeine and Alzheimer's Risk for builders.

hook.text: Coffee drinkers have a 65% lower risk of developing Alzheimer's disease compared to non-drinkers.

buildup.text: Adenosine receptor blockade may reduce inflammation and amyloid plaque formation—hallmarks of Alzheimer's.

discovery.text: Studies in mice show caffeine actively clears beta-amyloid proteins from the brain—not just preventing new buildup.

twist.text: The protective window seems to start in midlife. Lifelong coffee drinkers show the strongest benefit.

climax.text: Researchers are exploring caffeine-based therapies for neurodegenerative diseases, inspired by these coffee studies.

punchline.text: Your daily coffee might be protecting your future brain. Time will tell.

quiz.question: How might caffeine protect against Alzheimer's?
options: By reducing inflammation and potentially clearing amyloid plaques
